messages:
Samir (Partnerships): Heads-up — we're planning a breaking change to the partner SDK surface (v1 -> v2) that removes the legacy marketplace auth shim. Need to sync on timelines + migration aids. TGT: announce next Tuesday and start deprecation window 60 days after.
Mia (PM): Do we have a clear list of customers/integrations that use the marketplace shim today?
Samir (Partnerships): Lina has a list of partner integrations, Bob can confirm for Acme. I'll attach the matrix in the meeting invite.
Lina (Partner Eng): Confirmed: ~7 marketplace integrations using the shim, plus 3 SI bundles that assume the shim auth flow. Most use basic token exchange + fallback.
Bob (Acme Marketplace): FYI Acme relies on the shim for our auto-provision flow. 60 days is tight for our release calendar. What's the recommended migration path?
Aj (Eng-Platform): Recommended approach: (1) keep a compatibility adapter in hosted layer for 6 months, (2) provide an SDK shim library for partners to drop in, (3) publish a migration guide + code samples. We can gate the adapter behind a feature flag.
Mia (PM): Ok — that eases partner timelines. Can we commit to maintaining the hosted adapter for at least 180 days post-announcement? That gives partners two product cycles.
Aj (Eng-Platform): 180 days is doable if we scope the adapter as read-only auth translation. We'll add telemetry and an automatic opt-out. Need SRE/infra sign-off.
InfraBot: deploy-note: feature-flag "partners.sdk.v2.adapter" created by @aj. Canary window 24h, owner @aj.
Lina (Partner Eng): For partner-facing artifacts we need: migration checklist, compatibility matrix (routes + headers), and a lightweight npm/py package that calls the new auth endpoint. Can engineering deliver a sample client by EOW?
Aj (Eng-Platform): I can spin up a sample Node + Python client by Friday. Example snippet for clients to detect runtime and fallback:
```
// pseudo
if (process.env.USE_REDMIX_SHIM) {
  // call legacy exchange
} else {
  // call new token flow
}
```
Mia (PM): Legal asked for a communications plan (email + marketplace banner + changelog entry). Also want a developer webinar. Can partnerships lead partner comms? @Samir
Samir (Partnerships): Yes — we'll run partner comms. Suggest timeline: announcement Tue -> migration docs live Thu -> webinar 2 weeks after -> deprecation end 180 days.
Bob (Acme Marketplace): Can Redwood provide a temporary compatibility badge we can show in our marketplace listing if we test migration successfully? That would help adoption.
Mia (PM): Good idea. We'll coordinate with marketplace ops. Aj, can the shim emit a signed attestation we can hand to partners?
Aj (Eng-Platform): We can emit a short-lived signed token + status endpoint `/compat-status` for partners to programmatically verify migration. We'll add that.
Lina (Partner Eng): Need to add test vectors for token exchange edge-cases (clock skew, retries). Also call out consequences for older SDKs that hardcode header names.
Samir (Partnerships): Action items: @aj build sample clients + compat endpoint, @lina produce integration matrix, @mia draft comms, @bob confirm Acme timeline. I'll schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow 10am PT.
Bob (Acme Marketplace): Thanks — will confirm and flag internal PMs. Noted concern re: 60->180 day change. Appreciate the adapter plan.
Mia (PM): I'll draft announcement + webinar outline and post here for review.
Aj (Eng-Platform): One more: please document the semantic versioning policy in the migration guide (we're moving to strict semver for partner-facing SDKs). Put that under "Compatibility & Deprecation".
Samir (Partnerships): Agree. Also include rollback/playbook if we see marketplace broken integrations post-deprecation.
Lina (Partner Eng): Ok adding rollback steps and an emergency toggle we can enable for affected partners.
Samir (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — see calendar invite. If anything urgent ping me or @aj. :thumbsup:
